sample_selection: PR40 fixed pre-heldout hash rule, 1 of 1024 ICAO identities

initial_run.caveat: A timer anchoring bug incorrectly rejected valid irregularly spaced tracks.

corrected_run.compression_reference: gzip-compressed geometry arrays only, NOT full source archive or operational backend

limitations: Sample is small and not representative of global aviation or coverage.
Segment landing, clearance and normality are NOT independently verified; real PR42 retention gate was not applied.
Diagnostic adjacent-triplet probes are cadence-sensitive; 99 new bend and 60 new altitude positives after thinning do not indicate new physical events.
Zero full-resolution bend positives means this sample cannot establish sensitivity to true short lateral maneuvers.
A synthetic 1.5km excursion can be erased under the current 2km geometry allowance.
Actual aircraft corridor/deviation and prospective AIBA warning detectors were NOT run on these tracks.
No original-source deletion is authorized; retain high-resolution data while AIBA evidence/adjudication controls are built.
